title: Nipah Virus Infection: A Narrative Review of Clinical Spectrum, Pathogenesis, and Emerging Preventive and Therapeutic Strategies
abstract: Nipah virus (NiV) is known to be an emerging zoonotic pathogen of the Paramyxoviridae family, which was first identified in 1998, and is also associated with high morbidity and mortality due to severe encephalitis and respiratory illness. Transmission occurs through direct contact with infected animals, contaminated food, and human-to-human transmission , thereby further highlighting its epidemic potential. Despite significant advances in understanding its virology, pathogenesis, as well as clinical manifestations, NiV outbreaks continue to pose substantial public health challenges, usually in endemic regions. Current management of NiV remains largely supportive with no licensed antivirals or vaccines available, thus emphasising the need for effective medical countermeasures. Recent therapeutic developments must focus on monoclonal antibodies and antiviral agents, including Remdesivir, which have shown promising efficacy in preclinical studies. Vaccine candidates, including recombinant protein, viral vector, and mRNA-based platforms, are being examined in their early phases of clinical evaluation, showing potential for robust protection of immunity. Future research priorities must include the development of rapid point-of-care diagnosis, strengthening genomic surveillance while also implementing One Health approaches integrating human, animal and environmental data for the prevention of spillover events. Refining animal models and elucidating immune correlates of protection are very important aspects for translating preclinical successes into adequately licensed interventions for management approaches for NiV. Collaborative international frameworks as well as structured R&D roadmaps are critical options for the acceleration of vaccine and therapeutic development, thereby further ensuring rapid deployment during outbreaks. This narrative review article highlights current knowledge on the epidemiology of NiV, pathogenesis, clinical management, as well as emerging preventive-therapeutic strategies while also identifying critical research gaps. It underscores the need for a proactive, integrated approach which combines medical, public health and scientific efforts for the mitigation of the threat of NiV globally.

abstract_zh: 尼帕病毒 (NiV) 已知是副粘病毒科的一种新出现的人畜共患病原体,于 1998 年首次发现,并且由于严重的 脑炎 和呼吸道疾病,也与高发病率和 死亡率 相关。传播通过直接接触受感染的动物、受污染的食物以及人与人之间的传播发生,从而进一步凸显了其流行潜力。尽管在了解其病毒学、发病机制 以及临床表现方面取得了重大进展,但 NiV 暴发 仍然对公共卫生构成重大挑战,通常是在流行地区。目前 NiV 的管理在很大程度上仍然是支持性的,没有获得许可的 抗病毒药物 或 疫苗,因此强调需要采取有效的医疗对策。最近的治疗发展必须集中在单克隆抗体和 抗病毒药物 药物上,包括瑞德西韦,它们在临床前研究中显示出有希望的疗效。疫苗 候选药物,包括重组蛋白、病毒 媒介 和基于 mRNA 的平台,正在临床评估的早期阶段进行检查,显示出强大的免疫保护潜力。未来的研究重点必须包括开发快速护理点 诊断、加强 基因组监测,同时实施整合人类、动物和环境数据的“同一个健康”方法,以预防 跨物种溢出 事件。完善动物模型和阐明保护的免疫相关性是将临床前成功转化为获得充分许可的 NiV 管理方法干预措施的非常重要的方面。国际协作框架以及结构化研发路线图是加速 疫苗 和治疗开发的关键选择,从而进一步确保 暴发 期间的快速部署。这篇叙述性综述文章重点介绍了 NiV 的 流行病学、发病机制、临床管理以及新兴预防治疗策略的当前知识,同时还确定了关键的研究差距。它强调需要采取积极主动的综合方法,将医疗、公共卫生和科学努力结合起来,以减轻全球新病毒的威胁。

title: A Rapid Detection of Nipah Virus Nucleocapsid Antigen in Inactivated Viral Cultures.
abstract: Nipah virus (NiV) is a highly lethal zoonotic henipavirus that causes severe respiratory disease and encephalitis and remains a priority pathogen for outbreak preparedness. Timely diagnosis is essential for containment, yet nucleic acid-based testing is often impractical in outbreak-prone, resource-limited settings. Here, we report the development of a rapid antigen test for NiV based on a cellulose nanobead (CNB)-enhanced lateral flow immunoassay (LFIA) targeting the viral nucleocapsid protein (NP). Anti-NiV NP antibodies were isolated from human synthetic phage-display libraries (scFv and Fab) by iterative bio-panning, reformatted as full-length IgGs, and screened using ELISA and immunofluorescence assays. Four lead antibodies were advanced to a sandwich-pairing matrix, which identified an optimized capture-detection configuration (mAb #5 as capture; mAb #2 as detection). Bio-layer interferometry confirmed nanomolar binding affinities for the selected antibodies (K D = 39.50 nM for mAb #5; K D = 26.36 nM for mAb #2). The finalized CNB-LFIA produced results within 15 min and achieved an analytical limit of detection of 1 ng/mL for recombinant NiV NP. The assay observed no cross-reactivity with SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, or influenza A, whereas weak cross-reactivity for measles virus NP was observed only at a high antigen concentration (2 μg/mL). Using γ-irradiated cultured NiV quantified by RT-ddPCR, the LFIA detected viral load down to 4.1 × 10 7 copies/mL (4.1 × 106 copies/reaction) by a portable reader and 8.3 × 10 7 copies/mL (8.3 × 106 copies/reaction) by the naked eye. Collectively, this CNB-LFIA provides rapid, equipment-free NiV detection, supporting its potential utility for point-of-care diagnosis in resource-limited settings.

title_zh: 灭活病毒培养物中 尼帕病毒 核衣壳抗原的快速检测。
source_body_en: Nipah virus (NiV) is a highly lethal zoonotic henipavirus that causes severe respiratory disease and encephalitis and remains a priority pathogen for outbreak preparedness. Timely diagnosis is essential for containment, yet nucleic acid-based testing is often impractical in outbreak-prone, resource-limited settings. Here, we report the development of a rapid antigen test for NiV based on a cellulose nanobead (CNB)-enhanced lateral flow immunoassay (LFIA) targeting the viral nucleocapsid protein (NP). Anti-NiV NP antibodies were isolated from human synthetic phage-display libraries (scFv and Fab) by iterative bio-panning, reformatted as full-length IgGs, and screened using ELISA and immunofluorescence assays. Four lead antibodies were advanced to a sandwich-pairing matrix, which identified an optimized capture-detection configuration (mAb #5 as capture; mAb #2 as detection). Bio-layer interferometry confirmed nanomolar binding affinities for the selected antibodies (K D = 39.50 nM for mAb #5; K D = 26.36 nM for mAb #2). The finalized CNB-LFIA produced results within 15 min and achieved an analytical limit of detection of 1 ng/mL for recombinant NiV NP. The assay observed no cross-reactivity with SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, or influenza A, whereas weak cross-reactivity for measles virus NP was observed only at a high antigen concentration (2 μg/mL). Using γ-irradiated cultured NiV quantified by RT-ddPCR, the LFIA detected viral load down to 4.1 × 10 7 copies/mL (4.1 × 106 copies/reaction) by a portable reader and 8.3 × 10 7 copies/mL (8.3 × 106 copies/reaction) by the naked eye. Collectively, this CNB-LFIA provides rapid, equipment-free NiV detection, supporting its potential utility for point-of-care diagnosis in resource-limited settings.

title: Emerging infectious diseases (Mpox, Nipah, and Andes): A narrative review of transmission, environmental survival, and disinfection.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus are emerging infectious diseases that cause outbreaks associated with nosocomial transmission. METHODS: This narrative review summarizes the Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus epidemiology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment with a focus on environmental survival, susceptibility to antiseptics and disinfectants, and infection prevention. RESULTS: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus all survive in the environment and are capable of indirect transmission. All these viruses are enveloped and susceptible to commonly used antiseptics and surface disinfectants. CONCLUSIONS: Rapid identification of patients with known or suspected infections of these emerging viruses coupled with adherence to infection prevention recommendations will prevent healthcare-associated transmission.

METHODS: This narrative review summarizes the Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus epidemiology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment with a focus on environmental survival, susceptibility to antiseptics and disinfectants, and infection prevention. RESULTS: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus all survive in the environment and are capable of indirect transmission. All these viruses are enveloped and susceptible to commonly used antiseptics and surface disinfectants. CONCLUSIONS: Rapid identification of patients with known or suspected infections of these emerging viruses coupled with adherence to infection prevention recommendations will prevent healthcare-associated transmission.

title: Production of fucoidan from Scottish ocean farmed seaweed: optimisation of extraction methods, biological activity testing and future purification trends
abstract: Fucoidan is a long-chain sulphated polysaccharide, occurring naturally in brown seaweed species. The molecule has been reported in the literature to possess numerous biological activities, including antiviral, antioxidant, antifungal, antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, prebiotic, anticoagulant and anticancer properties. Therefore, the extract has garnered particular interest for application in the biomedical and nutraceutical markets. A diverse range of extract structures is possible, depending on both biological (seaweed species, age, harvest season and location) and process factors (extraction technique and conditions used). This presents a significant challenge because the relationships between extraction process variables and the resulting fucoidan product characteristics are poorly established. Furthermore, the specific characteristics a fucoidan extract must possess for a given bioactivity are unclear. This PhD thesis aimed to address these knowledge gaps, which present a significant barrier to fucoidan’s implementation as a commercial product. With this work ultimately designed to support the project's industrial partner, BioMara Ltd., desire to produce commercial seaweed-derived products for the nutraceutical and health supplement markets. Initial work focused on identifying potential fucoidan key quality attributes for antioxidant, antiviral, antifungal, antibacterial and prebiotic activities. This was achieved through a detailed characterisation of commercially available extracts, examining their monosaccharide profile, molecular weights and elemental content. These extracts then underwent biological activity testing, with highlights including antioxidant effects, approximately 80% inhibition of Nipah virus, around 60% inhibition of Candida dubliniensis growth and a doubling of Lactobacillus casei growth when exposed to fucoidans. Also tested were the fungal species Candida auris, Cryptococcus neoformans and the bacteria Klebsiella pneumoniae. Potential fucoidan key quality attributes for specific bioactivities were identified through a correlation analysis, indicating fucose content, sulphation degree and molecular weight were worthy of future study. Having identified potential key quality attributes, a Design of Experiments (DoE) methodology was employed to model and optimise both dilute acid and ultrasound-assisted extraction processes for yield as well as sulphate, antioxidant and polyphenol contents. A definitive Screening Design (DSD) was employed to identify statistically relevant process parameters for a given response before building a predictive model, which was validated with an experimental dataset. Next, antiviral and prebiotic activities were investigated further to better characterise the breadth of their effects and commercial potential. Antiviral studies focused on the effect of commercial fucoidan extracts on Influenza viral pseudotypes. A dose-dependent inhibition was observed, and the potency was determined through the fitting of IC50 curves. The reported IC50 values (16-38 μg mL-1) were comparable to other fucoidans in the literature and antiviral drugs, suggesting commercial potential for the extracts tested. The prebiotic effect of fucoidan was further explored using three assays. The first examined how selective the effect of fucoidan on probiotic bacterial growth (Lactobacillus casei and Lactobacillus rhamnosus) was compared to pathogenic (Escherichia coli) bacteria through a plate-based assay. Selective effects were observed for L. casei with one commercial fucoidan and for L. rhamnosus with an inulin extract. Next, the effect of extracts on the production of beneficial fatty acids (acetic, propanoic, butyric and lactic acids) was examined through GC/MS, with no sustained effect observed. Finally, the cytotoxic effects of fucoidan on Caco-2 cells, as a model for the gut, were studied, and no cytotoxicity was observed, suggesting extracts could be applied safely as a prebiotic supplement. The final chapter critically reviewed current purification methods (precipitation, membranes, and chromatography) employed in fucoidan production, including the underlying principles, advantages, and disadvantages of each method. Best practices for selecting an appropriate purification technique were established based on the final market of the product and the scale of production. Finally, perspectives on future technologies for fucoidan purification are provided, including the use of two-dimensional liquid chromatography for high-value bioactive applications.

abstract_zh: 褐藻糖胶是一种长链硫酸化多糖,天然存在于棕色海藻中。文献报道该分子具有多种生物活性,包括 抗病毒药物、抗氧化、抗真菌、抗菌、抗炎、益生元、抗凝血和抗癌特性。因此,该提取物在生物医学和营养保健市场的应用引起了特别的兴趣。根据生物因素(海藻种类、年龄、收获季节和地点)和工艺因素(使用的提取技术和条件),可能有多种提取物结构。这是一个重大挑战,因为提取工艺变量与所得岩藻依聚糖产品特性之间的关系尚未建立。此外,岩藻依聚糖提取物对于给定的生物活性必须具备的具体特征尚不清楚。本博士论文旨在解决这些知识空白,这些知识空白对岩藻依聚糖作为商业产品的实施构成了重大障碍。这项工作最终旨在支持该项目的工业合作伙伴 BioMara Ltd.,希望为营养保健品和保健品市场生产商业海藻衍生产品。最初的工作重点是确定岩藻依聚糖在抗氧化、抗病毒药物、抗真菌、抗菌和益生元活性方面的潜在关键质量属性。这是通过对市售提取物进行详细表征,检查其单糖特征、分子量和元素含量来实现的。然后,这些提取物接受了生物活性测试,重点包括抗氧化作用、尼帕病毒 约 80% 的抑制、都柏林念珠菌生长约 60% 的抑制以及暴露于岩藻依聚糖时干酪乳杆菌生长加倍。还测试了真菌种类耳念珠菌、新型隐球菌和肺炎克雷伯菌。通过相关分析确定了岩藻依聚糖特定生物活性的潜在关键质量属性,表明岩藻糖含量、硫酸化度和分子量值得未来研究。确定了潜在的关键质量属性后,采用实验设计 (DoE) 方法对稀酸和超声辅助提取工艺进行建模和优化,以提高产量以及硫酸盐、抗氧化剂和多酚含量。在建立预测模型之前,采用明确的筛选设计(DSD)来识别给定响应的统计相关过程参数,并使用实验数据集进行验证。接下来,进一步研究了 抗病毒药物 和益生元活性,以更好地表征其作用的广度和商业潜力。抗病毒药物 研究的重点是商业岩藻依聚糖提取物对流感病毒假型的影响。观察到剂量依赖性抑制,并通过拟合 IC50 曲线来确定效力。报告的 IC50 值(16-38 μg mL-1)与文献中的其他岩藻依聚糖和 抗病毒药物 药物相当,表明所测试的提取物具有商业潜力。使用三种测定法进一步探讨了岩藻依聚糖的益生元作用。第一项研究通过基于平板的测定,将岩藻依聚糖对益生菌(干酪乳杆菌和鼠李糖乳杆菌)生长的选择性影响与致病菌(大肠杆菌)进行比较。观察到使用一种市售岩藻依聚糖对干酪乳杆菌的选择性效应以及使用菊粉提取物对鼠李糖乳杆菌的选择性效应。接下来,通过 GC/MS 检查提取物对有益脂肪酸(乙酸、丙酸、丁酸和乳酸)产生的影响,但没有观察到持续影响。最后,研究了岩藻依聚糖对 Caco-2 细胞(作为肠道模型)的细胞毒性作用,没有观察到细胞毒性,这表明提取物可以安全地用作益生元补充剂。最后一章批判性地回顾了目前岩藻依聚糖生产中采用的纯化方法(沉淀、膜和色谱),包括每种方法的基本原理、优点和缺点。根据产品的最终市场和生产规模,建立了选择适当纯化技术的最佳实践。最后,提供了对未来岩藻依聚糖纯化技术的展望,包括使用二维液相色谱进行高价值生物活性应用。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 褐藻糖胶是一种来自褐海藻的硫酸化多糖,已报道了 抗病毒药物 特性,但提取变量、产品特性和特定生物活性之间的关系仍知之甚少,限制了其商业应用。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本博士论文重点关注岩藻依聚糖提取优化和生物活性测试,包括 抗病毒药物 测定,其工作旨在支持工业合作伙伴为营养保健品和保健品市场生产商业海藻衍生产品的目标。
analysis_zh.methods: 商业岩藻依聚糖提取物的特征在于单糖谱、分子量和元素含量,然后进行生物活性测试,包括使用剂量依赖性抑制和 IC50 曲线拟合对流感病毒假型进行 抗病毒药物 测定。
analysis_zh.main_results: 抗病毒药物 测试显示对流感病毒假型的剂量依赖性抑制,报告的 IC50 值在 16 至 38 μg mL-1 之间,与其他岩藻依聚糖和 抗病毒药物 药物相当,表明潜在的商业可行性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定了 抗病毒药物 活性的潜在岩藻依聚糖关键质量属性,并证明优化的提取工艺可以产生具有与现有药物相当的 抗病毒药物 效力的提取物,突出了商业潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,岩藻依聚糖提取物可以开发为 抗病毒药物 制剂或营养保健品,特别是对于需要天然生物活性化合物的市场,有待进一步验证和监管评估。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于使用流感假型的体外 抗病毒药物 测定,并不直接涉及 尼帕病毒;由于依赖商业提取物且缺乏针对特定目标的 尼帕病毒 测试,该研究的强度中等。
